entities.summary: Murad I, a notable figure in the history of Serbia, associated with Battle of Kosovo & Ottoman Conquest (1389–1389). Preceded by Battle of Kosovo (1389) and Battle of Kosovo – Prince Lazar and Sultan Murad I both killed. Their legacy influenced Serbian Despotate & Fall of Smederevo and Ottoman.
